notes.subject: אנחם
notes.rationale: נחם of foes: 'ease/comfort myself' (KJV 'ease me') vs 'avenge myself'; Tok Pisin 'stretim bel' holds the relief sense.

notes.subject: מצרי
notes.rationale: Literally 'from my distressers/those who tighten me'; rendered 'long ol birua bilong mi'.

notes.subject: מצרי/מאויבי
notes.rationale: Parallelism of two near-synonym prepositional phrases ('from my foes / from my enemies'); the paired structure is kept with two distinct Tok Pisin phrases.

translation: Olsem na, Yahwe Tsebaot i tok, Adonai, strongpela man bilong Yisrael: Hoi! Bai mi stretim bel bilong mi long ol birua bilong mi, na mi bekim olgeta man i les long mi.

tokens.gloss: olgeta man i les long mi
